name: recoveros
description: RecoverOS — hospital-connected recovery coordination and post-discharge management platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @recoveros/shared && npm run build -w @recoveros/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @recoveros/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:worker -w @recoveros/api
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w @recoveros/api
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @recoveros/shared && npm run test -w @recoveros/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @recoveros/api && npm run typecheck -w @recoveros/mobile
